# Synthetic Audio Player

This standalone WIPI-C example creates a media clip, supplies an original two-note SMAF byte sequence, changes clip volume, plays and stops the clip, and releases ownership during reload or Clet destruction.

- {download}`Application source <../../../examples/audio-player/main.c>`
